name: Argentine Beef Tenderloin with Malbec Sauce
recipeIngredient: 2 beef tenderloin steaks (4 to 6 oz each, about 1 inch thick)
1/2 tsp fresh rosemary (chopped, or 1/4 tsp dried)

recipeInstructions.text: Start the sweet potatoes and quinoa first, then sear the steaks while they cook.
Season beef tenderloin steaks with salt and black pepper. Let them sit at room temperature while you prep.
Heat olive oil in a cast iron skillet over high heat until shimmering. Sear the steaks 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare (135°F). Move to a plate, tent with foil, and rest.

itemListElement.text: Lower the heat to medium. Add butter and shallot and cook until soft, 2 minutes.
Pour in red wine, scraping up the browned bits. Simmer until reduced by half, 4-5 minutes.
Add beef broth, balsamic vinegar, and fresh rosemary. Simmer 3 minutes.
For a thicker sauce, stir in cornstarch mixed with 1 tbsp water and cook 1 minute. Season to taste.
Slice the steaks against the grain and spoon the sauce over.
